D/ IMP CONSTANTINVS AVG ; R/ SOLI INVIC TO COMITI

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantine I (306-337); small module Lyon mint Soli Invicto issue of 316, Reece period 15, in very fine condition, RIC. Vol. 7 page 125 no. 51. Obverse description: Youthful bust laureate draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: IMP CONSTANTINVS AVG.
